textual.context: Presented as the speaker's own earnings and an invitation to join a system or team; no explicit warning, denial, or discussion context is provided.
textual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship between promised daily earnings and requested replying, meeting participation, and joining the system or team may require later assessment of the offer and its conditions.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the earnings claims are accurate, whether joining requires payment or data submission, or what the system involves.

visual.observation: A repeated top-screen banner visibly invites viewers to join using a phone number and an ID number, while the monitor behind the presenter displays a crypto-like account dashboard with prominent percentage and BUSD-denominated figures.
visual.context: The relationship between the joining request and the displayed account figures is visible, but the purpose and context of the presentation are unclear from the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: A requested joining/contact action is visually linked to displayed financial-return or account-balance figures, which conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish what service is being offered, whether the figures represent actual returns or balances, whether any payment or transfer is requested, or whether the phone and ID details lead to any destination or outcome.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes joining his named team and system by claiming unusually high daily earnings, including Rs 5600 and up to Rs 50000 per day, while presenting his own reported earnings as support. He repeatedly invites viewers to join a meeting and become part of the team, making recruitment into the team the stated pathway to the promised income.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promotion links team enrollment with earning claims and repeatedly solicits viewers to join the speaker's team/system. This supports a recruitment-dependent earning mechanism under S06, although the supplied material does not show a specific payment amount, completed signup, or detailed tier qualification rule.
